caption: The drawing depicts a single large bird, specifically an eagle, perched on a horizontal cylindrical perch that is shown in a vertical orientation. The eagle is shown in profile view with its head turned slightly towards the viewer's left, displaying a strong, hooked beak and a muscular neck. The plumage of the eagle consists of overlapping feathers rendered in shades of brown, with highlights and lowlights that give a sense of texture and dimensionality; the wing feathers are elongated and show darker brown hues with subtle variations. The eagle's talons firmly grasp the perch, and the legs are feathered partway down. The neck and head feathers are shorter and colored in a reddish-brown, transitioning to darker tones further down the body. The background is a uniform, pale beige or cream color, with no other objects or details present, and the edges of the eagle are clearly delineated against this plain backdrop.
title: Finial Eagle
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
